Danielle M.: Postmortem follow-up: weekend meter gap caused delayed token batches for certain enterprise tenants. We saw under-reporting spikes in two windows (03:00-04:15 UTC, 12:40-13:05 UTC). Need concrete remediation actions: who owns customer-facing credits, who signs off on invoice reissues, and how we detect recurrence.

Ravi S.: I'll own the compensation policy and the ledger adjustments. Need impacted list + per-customer token delta. Can we get a confidence score on backfilled data? cc @Tessa G.

Tessa G.: Backfill ran and produced reconciled deltas; confidence depends on message ordering for older events. I ran a heuristic match and flagged ~220 customers with >5000 token delta. Uploading CSV to vault now.

Omar H.: Root cause: storm of broker GC pauses led to delayed consumer commits. Filed INF-5001 for durable commit path + staggered consumer restarts. ETA for durable commit change: 5 business days. Will add a monitoring alert for >1% daily delta per shard.

billing-bot: Preliminary summary: flagged_customers=220, total_missed_tokens=880000, est_credit_usd=$8,800. Reconcile_artifact: s3://redwood-prod/ingest-reconciles/2256789012/summary.csv

Danielle M.: Policy question: do we auto-credit below $50 USD or aggregate across billing period? Proposal: auto-credit for single-incident credit >= $1 and < $50, otherwise manual approval and invoice patch. Thoughts?

Ravi S.: Agree with aggregation across billing period. For larger credits (>=$50) need finance+legal signoff. I'll draft a short decision doc and run it by Legal.

Tessa G.: For detection going forward, suggest this periodic query (cron hourly) and alerting rule: ```sql
-- hourly job: find customers with >0.5% token delta in last 24h
SELECT customer_id,
  SUM(missed_tokens) AS missed_tokens,
  SUM(missed_tokens)::float / NULLIF(SUM(reporting_tokens),0) AS frac
FROM ingest_reconciles
WHERE reconcile_ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING SUM(missed_tokens)::float / NULLIF(SUM(reporting_tokens),0) > 0.005;
``` Will open a monitoring ticket to add this as a pager threshold for oncall.

Danielle M.: Good. Also need comms plan: brief to affected customers, internal postmortem summary, and an FAQ for customer success. Tessa can you attach an anonymized sample for CS?

Tessa G.: Uploaded sample CSV to vault: vault://finance/reconciles/2256789012/sample.csv. CS can use that to copy language.

Legal Team: We'll need the wording for credits and confirmation that amounts don't change contract terms. Please route the draft through us before sending.

Ravi S.: Drafted compensation calc (in repo): ``formula: credit_usd = missed_tokens * token_rate_usd`` token_rate_usd set per-customer from billing profile. For promo/credits already applied, subtract before final amount.

Danielle M.: Action items + owners: 1) Ravi  compensation policy + invoice patch runbook (due 2026-04-02) 2) Tessa  final reconcile artifacts & detection alert (due 2026-03-26) 3) Omar  infra fix & monitoring (INF-5001, due 2026-04-07) 4) Legal  sign-off on comms + thresholds (review by 2026-03-27).

billing-bot: Follow-up checklist created: board=https://boards.internal/redwood/billing-postmortem/2256789012. Next check-in scheduled: 2026-03-25 17:00 UTC.

Omar H.: Noted. Will also run a small canary patch for durable commits in prod-limited tomorrow and report results here.

Danielle M.: Thanks team. We'll close out when ledger has been patched and customer notifications sent. Will update stakeholders after Legal + Finance approval.
